Lauren — thanks for the ping. Finance guidance below:

1) Cost center: please use CC-4302 (Field Mktg — Events) for the sponsorship deposit and final invoice.
2) PO process: We can issue a two-line PO that lists the deposit (50%) and the balance due. Provide the vendor legal name and W-9; procurement will open PO PR-9876.
3) Accounting treatment: If invoice is received before period close, we record the deposit to Prepaid Sponsorship (GL 6109) and amortize on event delivery.
4) Refundable deposit (force majeure): Finance can accept a refundable-deposit clause but requires contract language that limits refund to (a) full venue cancellation or (b) state-mandated prohibitions; general streaming interruptions do not qualify. Any refund trigger must be specific and timebound.

Action items for you:
- Get Avery to provide vendor legal name and a completed W-9 (or equivalent tax form).
- Confirm whether they will accept Redwood's standard force-majeure wording; if not, we need their proposed clause in writing for legal review.

I'll start a PR in Coupa and loop procurement once we have the vendor name. Ben — can you help confirm whether we have any historical refunds or similar clauses for 2024 events?

Marcus
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

Subject: Re: Emerald Track sponsorship — deposit & PO details

Hi Hannah — thanks, and excited to move forward. A few points to confirm before we issue a PO:

1) Cost center and PO: Finance requested we bill to cost center CC-4302. Please confirm your vendor legal name and send over a completed W-9. Once we have that, procurement will open PR-9876 and a PO will be generated.

2) Deposit timing & payment: We are prepared to approve the 50% deposit upon receipt of your invoice, processed via standard payment terms. Please mark the invoice 'Deposit — 50%'.

3) Refund/force majeure: Redwood can accept a refundable-deposit clause limited to venue cancellation or government-ordered event prohibition. We cannot accept broad refund language for streaming outages or attendee no-shows. If you want broader refund triggers, please provide the exact clause so our legal/finance teams can review.

4) Contract rider and livestream demo: Monica — we will need a short rider clarifying booth-power, AV support windows for product demos, and recording rights. Monica will follow up with technical specs.

Next steps: send W-9 + vendor name to marcus.lin@redwood.com, provide the invoice marked for deposit, and share any proposed contract language you want Redwood to consider. I’ll hold the slot for Redwood conditionally until EOD 6/20.

Best,
Lauren
